# MBG agent tools

Every command prints exactly one JSON envelope on stdout (`schema: mbg.result/1`):

| field | meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| `ok` | `false` only when the tool itself failed (bad input, crash); see `error` |
| `status` | verdict on the design: `PASS`, `FAIL`, `PARTIAL`, `NOT RUN`, `NOT AVAILABLE` |
| `summary` | one line to act on |
| `metrics` | small numbers (full data stays on disk) |
| `artifacts` | paths: GDS, reports, CSV, logs |
| `issues` | `{code, severity, message, hint}`, errors first, at most 20 |
| `next` | suggested next commands |
| `job` | for long tools still running: `{id, state}` -> `mbg job wait <id>` |

Exit codes: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL/PARTIAL, 2 usage error, 3 NOT RUN/NOT AVAILABLE, 4 still running. Numbers accept SPICE suffixes (`20u`, `1p`). Objects are inline JSON or a path to a `.json` file. Any tool also takes `--args-json '{...}'`.

Over MCP (`scripts/mbg mcp`) the same tools are published with underscores; tools sharing a group are one MCP tool with a selector (`pdk` action=list|info, `design` action=init|status, `verify` check=drc|lvs|pex, `job` action=status|wait|cancel).

## `mbg doctor`

Check the environment: Python stack, Magic/netgen/KLayout/ngspice versions, installed PDKs. Run first; tells you which stages can run.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |

    mbg doctor

## `mbg pdk list`

List supported PDK variants and whether each is installed.

    mbg pdk list

## `mbg pdk info`

What is legal in a PDK: supply, device models with terminal order and size limits, which devices the layout engine supports, simulation corners, sign-off decks, the tested complexity ceiling.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--section` | string (devices|sim|verification|supply|conventions|tested_ceiling) | Only one section |
| `--model` | string | Only this device model |

    mbg pdk info --pdk gf180mcuD --section devices
    mbg pdk info --model pnp_10p00x10p00

## `mbg design init`

Create a design workspace outputs/<name>/ (AGENTS.md artifact layout + experiment.json). Later calls take --design <name>.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<name>` / `--name` | string | Workspace name: 3-128 lowercase letters, digits and '-' (it is the experiment id) **(required)** |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--netlist` | string | SPICE file to copy in as generated_netlist.spice |
| `--spec` | object/string | Specification: {metric: {op, target, unit, tol}} (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--prompt` | string | Original request text, kept as prompt.txt |
| `--model` | string | Identifier of the AI model driving this experiment (recorded in experiment.json) |
| `--prompt-level` | string (minimal|constraint-based|detailed) | Prompt detail level |
| `--description` | string | One-line description |

    mbg design init bgr1 --pdk gf180mcuD --netlist bgr.spice

## `mbg design status`

Summarise a workspace: which stages ran, their status, key metrics and artifacts.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<name>` / `--name` | string | Workspace name **(required)** |

    mbg design status bgr1

## `mbg netlist check`

Static checks before simulating or laying out: syntax, models vs the PDK catalogue, terminal counts, W/L limits and units, body ties, instance prefixes, floating nets, layout support per device, and complexity against the tested ceiling. No EDA tools needed.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |

    mbg netlist check ota.spice

## `mbg sim run`

Simulate the subcircuit with ngspice in a generated testbench: op, dc (source, supply or temp sweep), ac or tran. Returns per-probe summaries; full data goes to CSV in the run directory.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--analysis` | string (op|dc|ac|tran) | Analysis **(required)** |
| `--corner` | string | Process corner, e.g. typical/ff/ss/fs/sf (gf180) or tt/ff/ss/sf/fs (sky130). 'typical' and 'tt' are accepted for both. |
| `--temp` | number | Temperature in C (default 27) |
| `--supplies` | object | DC supplies {node: volts}, e.g. {"VDD": 3.3, "VSS": 0} |
| `--sources` | object | Other DC sources {node: volts or ngspice source spec} |
| `--isources` | object | Current sources {node: amps} pushing current INTO the node from ground; {node: [from_node, amps]} from another node |
| `--loads` | object | Load capacitors {node: value}, e.g. {"VREF": "1p"} |
| `--probes` | string[] | Nodes or expressions to record, e.g. VREF i(Vsupply0) |
| `--sweep` | object | dc: {source, start, stop, step}; source may be a supply node or 'temp' |
| `--ac` | object | ac: {fstart, fstop, points, node} |
| `--tran` | object | tran: {step, stop} |
| `--post-layout` | boolean | Simulating an extracted (PEX) netlist |

    mbg sim run ota.spice --analysis op --supplies '{"VDD":3.3,"VSS":0}' --sources '{"INP":1.65,"INN":1.65}' --probes OUT

## `mbg measure vref`

Characterise a voltage reference: VREF at 27 C, temperature coefficient (box method), line regulation, supply current, IBIAS sensitivity, PSRR, startup, across corners; evaluates a spec. Works on schematic and PEX netlists.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--ports` | object | Port roles {vdd, vss, vref, ibias}; default: the ports named VDD, VSS, VREF, IBIAS |
| `--vdd` | number | Nominal supply (default: the PDK nominal) |
| `--vdd-range` | number[] | Line-regulation window [lo, hi] in V |
| `--temp-range` | number[] | Temperature sweep [lo, hi, step] in C |
| `--ibias` | number | Bias current into IBIAS in A (default 20e-6; 0 = none) |
| `--ibias-dir` | string (source|sink) | 'source' pushes IBIAS into the pin, 'sink' pulls it out |
| `--ibias-sweep` | number[] | IBIAS values for the sensitivity check, A |
| `--cl` | string | Load capacitance on VREF (default 1p) |
| `--corners` | string[] | Corners to run (default: the nominal corner only; 'all' for every corner) |
| `--quick` | boolean | Skip PSRR, startup and IBIAS sensitivity |
| `--spec` | object/string | Specification, or 'vref_md' for prompt-test/VREF.md, or 'bandgap' for the stretch targets (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--post-layout` | boolean | Simulating an extracted (PEX) netlist |

    mbg measure vref vref.spice --spec vref_md --corners all

## `mbg measure ota`

Characterise an amplifier: DC gain, -3 dB bandwidth, unity-gain frequency, phase margin and supply current.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--out` | string | Output node **(required)** |
| `--inp` | string | Non-inverting input node **(required)** |
| `--inn` | string | Inverting input node (biased at the common mode) |
| `--supplies` | object | {node: volts} |
| `--bias` | object | Other DC nodes {node: volts} |
| `--vcm` | number | Input common mode (default VDD/2) |
| `--cl` | string | Load capacitance on the output (default 1p) |
| `--corner` | string | Process corner, e.g. typical/ff/ss/fs/sf (gf180) or tt/ff/ss/sf/fs (sky130). 'typical' and 'tt' are accepted for both. |
| `--spec` | object/string | Specification (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--post-layout` | boolean | Simulating an extracted (PEX) netlist |

    mbg measure ota ota.spice --out OUT --inp INP --inn INN

## `mbg spec check`

Evaluate metrics against a specification; PASS only if every required spec is met.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--metrics` | object/string | Measured metrics {name: value} (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) **(required)** |
| `--spec` | object/string | Specification {name: {op, target, unit, tol, required}}, or 'vref_md' / 'bandgap' (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) **(required)** |

    mbg spec check --metrics m.json --spec spec.json

## `mbg layout generate`

SPICE -> GDS with the analog placer and DRC-aware router, then Magic + KLayout DRC, netgen LVS and PEX. Placement hints steer the placer. *(long: runs as a background job)*

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--hints` | object/string | Placement hints: {rows: {dev: row}, order: {row: [devs]}, groups: [{kind, devices}], fixed: {dev: {x, y}}, array: [{devices, cols}]} (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--placement` | object | PlacementConfig overrides, e.g. {channel_x: 3} |
| `--router` | object | RouterConfig overrides |
| `--verify` | boolean | Run DRC/LVS/PEX after layout (default true) |
| `--wait-s` | number | Seconds to wait for a long tool before returning a job id (default 540 on the CLI, 50 over MCP). The work continues in the background; collect it with `mbg job wait <id>`. |

    mbg layout generate ota.spice
    mbg layout generate --design bgr1 --hints hints.json

## `mbg layout view`

Text view of a generated layout: ASCII floorplan, device boxes, rows, per-device nets and routing failures, in the coordinates hints use.

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<run>` / `--run` | string | Run directory of a layout.generate call, or a layout.json file |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--format` | string (ascii|json) | ascii (default) or json |
| `--width` | integer | ASCII width in characters (default 72) |

    mbg layout view outputs/runs/<id>

| `--wait-s` | number | Seconds to wait for a long tool before returning a job id (default 540 on the CLI, 50 over MCP). The work continues in the background; collect it with `mbg job wait <id>`. |

    mbg verify drc cell.gds

## `mbg flow run`

One call from netlist to sign-off: netlist check, pre-layout measurement, layout + DRC/LVS/PEX, post-layout measurement on the extracted netlist, spec evaluation pre vs post. *(long: runs as a background job)*

| argument | type | description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `<netlist>` / `--netlist` | string | Path to a SPICE file with exactly one .subckt. Omit when --design names a workspace that has one. |
| `--pdk` | string | PDK variant or family: gf180mcuD (default), gf180, sky130A, sky130. Omit to infer it from the netlist's device models. |
| `--design` | string | Design workspace name (from `mbg design init`). Artifacts then go to outputs/<design>/<stage>/ instead of outputs/runs/. |
| `--recipe` | string (vref|ota|none) | Measurement recipe |
| `--recipe-args` | object | Arguments for the recipe (as for measure.<recipe>) |
| `--spec` | object/string | Specification (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--hints` | object/string | Placement hints (as for layout.generate) (inline JSON object, or a path to a .json file) |
| `--wait-s` | number | Seconds to wait for a long tool before returning a job id (default 540 on the CLI, 50 over MCP). The work continues in the background; collect it with `mbg job wait <id>`. |

    mbg flow run --design bgr1 --recipe vref --spec vref_md
